name: コンビニ
description: A busy convenience store with white shelves full of drinks, snacks, and cups of instant noodles. Tall shelves stand in the middle with products on both sides, and a row of shelves runs along the back wall. A glass drinks fridge lines the left wall, and a tall glass cooler stands in the back right corner. At the front, a checkout counter has a cash register, a card reader, a conveyor belt, and paper bags, with a cashier in a red uniform behind it. A customer waits to pay in front of the counter. A hot food case holds rice balls and hot dogs, and a spinning snack rack and a magazine rack stand near the front. A stack of shopping baskets sits on the floor. Customers walk the aisles, one carrying a basket, one looking at drinks in the fridge, and one looking at a phone.
